; Clerkenwell device adapter.
;
; Implements the insertion handshake of investigation 3 (docs/investigations.md):
;
;     GET /command  -> the pending command for THIS doc+page, or empty
;     GET /attempt  -> host durably records an attempt; 200 authorizes the call
;     insertImageFileAsSceneItem(...)
;     GET /ack      -> report inserted | failed
;
; The ordering is the contract. The host persists the attempt BEFORE replying
; 200, and the adapter refuses to insert without that 200. A crash between the
; attempt and the ack therefore leaves an `uncertain` result that the host must
; reconcile by inspection -- never by automatic replay. That is the spec's model
; and it is deliberately not an exactly-once claim.
;
; Guards, in the order the spec requires them:
;   - one outstanding command at a time (inFlight), so the 1s poll cannot start
;     a second cycle while XHR callbacks are still pending
;   - identity is rechecked immediately before the insertion call, not merely
;     when the command was loaded, so a page turn mid-handshake aborts
;   - the command is validated (protocol version, required fields, finite
;     coordinates) before anything is recorded
;   - unsupported viewport states (zoom, non-notepage, page error) are skipped
;
; Host side: bb tools/insert-harness.clj  (see its --help)
; Tunnel:    ssh -R 127.0.0.1:14242:127.0.0.1:14242 <rm-host-alias>
;
; Published copies of this file are hashed with qmldiff against the hashtab
; for firmware 3.27.1.0 (tools/publish).
;
; Compatible with: firmware 3.27.1.0 (snorlax).
